dct_creator_sm: Natural Resources Canada (Geological Survey of Canada, Natural Resources Canada).
dct_description_sm: The comparison of digital coastlines across various time intervals allows for an accurate representation of coastal change. A better understanding of coastal change and its relationship to the changing morphology of coastal and inland waterways will aid in future decision-making for development and management of one of the most rapidly changing coastlines in the world.
dct_title_s: Cliff edge, Tuktoyaktuk 1947 to 2008, Beaufort Sea, northern Canada
